official: 東京都女性福祉資金貸付条例の一部を改正する条例

sources.label: 令和8年第1回定例会 提出議案と議決結果

name: 専修学校の専攻科も貸付対象に
summary: 現在、女性福祉資金の修学資金と就学支度資金では、専修学校の専門課程が貸付対象です。令和8年4月1日から、専攻科も対象に加わります。
changes: 修学資金の貸付対象に専修学校の専攻科を加える
就学支度資金の貸付対象に専修学校の専攻科を加える
who: 専修学校の専攻科で学ぶ、または入学する女性等
why: 女性福祉資金の貸付事業を充実させるためと、都は説明しています。

en.name: Adds advanced courses at specialized training colleges to loan eligibility
en.official: Ordinance Partially Amending the Tokyo Metropolitan Government Women's Welfare Fund Loan Ordinance
en.summary: Currently, the study loan and school enrollment preparation loan under the Women's Welfare Fund are available for professional courses at specialized training colleges. From April 1, 2026, advanced courses will also be eligible.
changes: Adds advanced courses at specialized training colleges to the study loan eligibility
Adds advanced courses at specialized training colleges to the school enrollment preparation loan eligibility
who: Women and others who study or enroll in advanced courses at specialized training colleges
en.why: The Tokyo Metropolitan Government says this is to improve its Women's Welfare Fund loan program.
